scope: Fail closed when a DWG modeler declares separate wireframe/silhouette data that the current DXF projection does not model. This does not decode those records or qualify ACIS geometry.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: A true wireframe-presence bit is followed by optional wireframe and silhouette records after the ACIS carrier.
authority.note: The PDF path listed in AGENTS.md was unavailable in this workspace; no DWG parser layout was changed.

implementation.behavior: writeModelerGeometry refuses m_hasWireframe=true before publishing DXF output, with an explicit unqualified-wireframe mapping diagnostic.
implementation.reason: The writer currently maps only the admitted ACIS SAT/SAB carrier and has no typed mapping for the separate DWG display wireframe/silhouette fields.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Uses a from-scratch AC1024 SAB vector; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

validation.coverage: ASCII and Binary tests set the source wireframe flag, require refusal with the prior destination unchanged, clear the unrepresented flag, retry through the same exporter, then verify typed SAT-carrier readback and subsequent read-write-read preservation.

limitations: Only the explicit true-bit output-loss case is guarded; the DWG wireframe and silhouette bodies remain opaque.
The guard does not establish whether every consumer can regenerate equivalent display data from ACIS.
This generated vector does not qualify physical producer behavior, 3D semantics, native CAD acceptance, or a broad support claim.
